semiconductor_relevance: High — Kelvin Quantum develops specialized electronics for quantum technology that operates at cryogenic temperatures, directly impacting semiconductor applications in quantum computing.
summary: Kelvin Quantum Ltd specializes in developing electronics for quantum technology, focusing on readout and control systems that function at ultra-low temperatures. Their Cryo-CMOS hardware addresses critical bottlenecks in scalable quantum systems by integrating electronics within cryogenic refrigeration systems, enhancing performance and measurement precision.
capabilities: Cryogenic-capable mixed-signal and analogue RF ASICs
Complete packaged solutions for cryogenic environments

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Based in Glasgow, Scotland, Kelvin Quantum operates in the UK with a focus on developing cryogenic electronics.
